libs.note: BH-9885: the deterministic triage gate's queue-gates brake (step 2). When the queue bytes and every referenced PR's state are unchanged it answers SKIP queue-gates-unchanged until this hard recheck passes, UNLESS bin/lib/triage-gate-untriaged.sh finds a NEW or moved-and-unverdicted ticket on the live board, which answers RUN board-changed. Applied through lib_env_apply triage-gate <project> in tgu_hard_recheck_s.

knobs.note: How long the queue-gates brake holds an unchanged PR-gated queue before a forced queue-pending run. Code fallback 14400 (4 h), read as ${QUEUE_GATE_HARD_RECHECK_S:-14400}; a non-integer or a value under 2700 (the 45-minute queue-unchanged window) falls back to 14400.
